text: A Modular card with a mod applied is modded, so it is Unstable: when it leaves the stack, whether it resolved, failed to resolve or was negated, it and its mods are erased instead of going to a bin. An unmodded Modular card goes to the bin as usual.

examples.text: Example: A graft card in the bin is applied to Spellbind, resolves with it, and is erased, so it cannot be applied this way again.
